_comment: TRAJYX dark basemap. Raster tiles from OpenStreetMap so the risk map renders with no API key on a clean checkout. Desaturated and darkened via raster paint properties so the risk overlay is the brightest thing on screen — the whole point of the map is the risk colours, and a full-colour basemap competes with them. For production cartography, point VITE_MAP_STYLE_URL at a vector style.
name: TRAJYX Dark
